$comment: Byte ceilings per key route for the CI gate (scripts/perf/bytes.mjs, docs/design/PERFORMANCE.md). KB is 1,024 bytes of transfer (encoded body plus headers). scriptKB caps the compressed script transfer of the first load, totalKB everything the load fetched. Lower a ceiling when a route gets smaller; raise one only with a reason recorded in PERFORMANCE.md. A script ceiling above 200 is a ratchet for a route still over the architecture's 200 KB budget and drops to 200 when the route gets there.
